output: SELECT s.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.start_station_id = s.station_id THEN 1 END) as trips_started, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id = s.station_id THEN 1 END) as trips_ended FROM station s LEFT JOIN trip t ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id OR s.station_id = t.end_station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name;
